name: manual_3060e4
claim: When a git branch has diverged from origin with unrelated concurrent commits, reset --hard to origin tip and re-apply only your own deltas as fresh edits, rather than fighting an interactive rebase across duplicate/superseded history

decisions.notes: Rebase onto origin/branch produced 'would be overwritten by merge' errors and dropped commits as 'already upstream' - the local branch had diverged with an unrelated concurrent start.ps1 rewrite. Aborting rebase and reset --hard + manual re-diff was faster and lower-risk than resolving the interactive rebase conflicts.
